description: Blog images for 'Writing the History of Software' — Dina's watercolor style. Consistent pink-haired woman architect character. SDXL refiner ON (detail pass), 35 steps, quality negatives. Concept-forward prompts optimized for CLIP 77-token limit. Prompts tightened to survive token truncation while maintaining the book/Squad/stewardship narrative metaphors.

prompts.prompt: Watercolor painting, wet-on-wet washes, warm muted tones. Confident pink-haired woman software architect at a forked road at golden hour holding an open field notebook labeled project book filled with tiny architecture sketches, beside her a modern autonomous car symbolizing Squad, wooden signs point to quick fixes and safe grounded progress, atmospheric clouds, gentle ink outlines, hand-painted editorial style, 16:9

prompts.prompt: Watercolor diptych with continuous horizon, pink-haired woman on both sides. Left: software archaeology with dusty ruins, fragmented code tablets, tangled cables, faded commit notes, muted earth tones. Right: software stewardship with cultivated garden, labeled pathways, healthy branching trees shaped like repo graphs, organized notebooks, fresh greens and warm light, loose wet-on-wet, subtle linework, 3:2
